DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City DILG OPINION No. 99 s. 2022 September 19, 2022 ATTY. ROGELIO P. LEGASPI Associate Lawyer VOX LAW OFFICE No. 467 Sitio Baiso, Calahan Cardona, Rizal voxlaw461@qmail.com Dear Atty. Legaspi: This has reference to your letter dated August 9, 2022 inquiring on the following, which we quoted in toto: 2. 3. Can your Provincial Director for the Province of Bohol issue a Certification with effect of appointing the Municipal Vice- Mayor as Municipal Mayor of Alicia, Bohol? Can your Regional Director for Region 7 and Provincial Director for the Province of Bohol can declare vacancy to the Office of the Municipal Mayor of Alicia, Bohol, despite lack of writ of execution? and Can a private lawyer or the Municipal Vice-Mayor can implement or serve the official document(s) coming from your Regional Office or Provincial Office, without any official staff member from said offices?" As to the first and second issues, the Certification dated August 4, 2022 issued by Provincial Director Jerome G. Gonzales of DILG-Bohol is not equivalent to an appointment of the Municipal Vice-Mayor as Municipal Mayor of Alicia, Bohol. Said Certification only certifies or confirms as to who is at present discharging the duties and functions of the Office of the Mayor, hence, a declaration of fact. Appointment is defined as the selection, by the authority vested with power, of an individual who is to exercise the functions of a given office. Our Provincial Director is not vested with power to select who should assume as Municipal Mayor. It was clearly indicated in the Certification that Cesyl Balahay assumed the Office of the Mayor by virtue of succession, that is, by operation of law. "By operation of law" means acquisition of certain rights or responsibilities automatically under the law, without taking individual action or being the subject of a court order. Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Further, please be informed that the communication of RD Trovela dated July 18, 2022 declaring the existence of a permanent vacancy in the Office of the Mayor was issued without knowing of the RTC's decision on the Petition for Quo Warranto. The advice is in consonance with the facts available at the time of its issuance and the declaration of vacancy was in accordance with the circumstances provided under the Local Govemment Code. Such was done to prevent paralysis of government operations. However, the aforesaid guidance rendered by DILG Region VII has become moot and inapplicable in light of the subsequent events that took place. Nevertheless, considering that the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) has jurisdiction over issues and cases arising from the national and local elections, this Department is requesting the Commission's guidance relative to the ruling of RTC Branch 51. Pending guidance from the COMELEC and the final disposition of the Petition for Quo Warranto, this Department is constrained to declare a temporary vacancy in the Office of the Mayor to prevent hiatus and paralysis in the government operations. Section 46 of the Local Government Code of 1991 provides for the procedure in filling in the temporary vacancy in the office of the Local Chief Executive, to wit: SECTION 46. Temporary Vacancy in the Office of the Local Chief Executive. — (a) When the governor, city or municipal mayor, or punong barangay is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties for physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence, travel abroad, and suspension from office, the vice-governor. citv or municipal vice-mavor. or the highest ranking sangquniang baranqay member shall automaticallv exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. Hence, for the meantime, the duly elected Vice-Mayor, Hon. Cesyl L. Balahay, shall sit as Acting Mayor by virtue of automatic succession. Meanwhile, the highest Sangguniang Bayan Member, Marciano S. Ayuban, Jr., pursuant to Administrative Order No. 151 per designation by the Secretary of DILG, shall sit as Acting Vice- Mayor. As to the third issue, the directives issued by the DILG-Central Office or any of its Regional Offices are implemented and given effect by our authorized Department personnel so that it excludes a private lawyer nor the Vice-Mayor unless of course it also involves the duties and functions of the Vice-Mayor. 1 Issuance dated December 13, 2018 issued by the President authorizing the DILG Secretary or its Officer-in-Charge to fill temporary vacancies in certain local government offices to prevent hiatus in and paralysis of local government operations and DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2019-21. Page 2 of 3

The foregoing is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you.
